record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Let (X,tau) be a co-sober T0 space, and let k:(X,tau)->(X,tau) be continuous. Suppose k is a kernel operator for the specialization order, meaning k(x) lies in cl{x} and k(k(x))=k(x) for every x in X. Is the image subspace (k(X), tau restricted to k(X)) co-sober?

evidence.quote: Question 9.5. Let (X, τ ) be a co-sober space and k : (X, τ ) → (X, τ ) a continuous mapping for which k : X → X is a kernel operator with respect to the specialization order of X, that is, k(x) ∈ cl{x} and k(k(x)) = k(x) for any x ∈ X. Is the subspace (k(X), τ |k(X)) co-sober?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\tau)$ be a $T_0$ topological space. The specialization order $\le$ on $X$ is defined by $x \le y$ iff $x \in \overline{\{y\}}$. An irreducible closed subset of $X$ is a nonempty closed set $A$ that cannot be written as the union of two proper closed subsets of itself. The space $(X,\tau)$ is called sober if every irreducible closed subset is the closure of a unique point. Dually, a nonempty subset $F \subseteq X$ is called irreducible compact saturated (with appropriate definitions) and $(X,\tau)$ is called co-sober if every irreducible compact saturated subset of $X$ is the saturation $\mathord{\uparrow} x = \{y : x \le y\}$ of a unique point $x \in X$ (equivalently, every "irreducible" element of the relevant lattice of compact saturated sets is the principal filter of a point).

Let $(X,\tau)$ be a co-sober $T_0$ space and let $k : (X,\tau) \to (X,\tau)$ be a continuous self-map which is a kernel operator with respect to the specialization order, meaning that for every $x \in X$:
\begin{itemize}
\item $k(x) \in \overline{\{x\}}$ (equivalently $k(x) \le x$), and
\item $k(k(x)) = k(x)$.
\end{itemize}
Equip the image $k(X) \subseteq X$ with the subspace topology $\tau|_{k(X)}$. Is the subspace $(k(X), \tau|_{k(X)})$ necessarily co-sober?
artifact.status_search_result: A direct web search did not turn up any published resolution of this question. It is posed as an explicit open question on co-sober spaces and kernel operators with respect to specialization order, and no follow-up work resolving it was located.
